term: persistent relational knowledge and possible knowledge
definition: Three worlds embed into the first three worlds of the earlier epistemic model, giving E blocks{0,1},{2}; the reused universal modal frame restricts to R universal, so E⊆R. Actuality is information stage1. Knowledge and possibility are constructed as upper closures of the matching existing relational extensions; OperatorsExact proves closure adds no world for persistent contents. Moore content is p meet the Heyting pseudocomplement of Kp.
note: The model checks factivity, top/conjunction preservation, normal distribution, positive introspection and the explicitly stated Heyting negative-introspection inequality. These individual laws are not advertised as soundness/completeness for an entire IK/IS5 calculus. Applicability to actual human knowledge, possible learning and anti-realism remains OPEN.
